messages.subject: For David Rae | Responsible mining, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Dundee Precious Metals Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. David Rae, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Dundee Precious Metals' international operating footprint requires disciplined alignment across governments, communities, sustainability commitments and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex regulatory and stakeholder matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support Dundee Precious Metals' responsible-mining, government-relations, ESG or international stakeholder priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Dundee Precious Metals.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
